title: WorkstreamDispatchOutcomeNote
description: Closed v1 outcome-note schema. The dispatched agent writes this file beside its job record; Arjim only reads it (R26, KTD11). The note is one mutable snapshot per job — a later write at the same derived path replaces what the next answer reads. The path is derived from `job_id` (`<job-id>.note.json` inside `.workstream/dispatch/`) and is never recorded in the job record. Nothing in the note is trusted as verified truth or as a confirmed claim of authorship; it is reported as an unverified workspace note associated with the job.

schema_version.description: Note contract version; readers dispatch on it before applying the closed schema. v1 allowed value: 1.

job_id.description: Must match the job record's `job_id`. A note whose `job_id` differs is `mismatched` and its content is never rendered (R26).

summary.description: Bounded free-text outcome summary from the dispatched agent. Untrusted input passed through the dispatch-local guard at read time (U6, KTD13).

reported_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the agent reported this outcome. Rendered beside the note's claim in status answers (R26).
